div.div: AI resources that create other AI resources — one orchestrator, three phases, four resource types

switch.text: AI resources that create other AI resources — one orchestrator, three phases, four resource types

div.div:
2. Classify
Determine resource type,
complexity, name

3. Design
Create design.md + diagrams
(adapts by resource type)

Adapts by type:
Skill → design + flow + sequence
Rule → minimal (purpose + globs)
Workflow → design + flow
Agent → design + flow + seq + delegation

2. Scaffold
Create resource files
(frontmatter + structure, no impl)

3. Implement
Fill in steps, logic, commands
(step-by-step with user)

Adapts by type:
Skill → SKILL.md + README.md
Rule → rules/name.md
Workflow → .windsurf/workflows/name.md
Agent → AGENT.md + sub-agent AGENT.mds

1. Detect type
Read frontmatter / file location

2. Select strategy
Choose test approach by type
